resources.string: Help
Help
Close help
Got it
Everything comes back by itself
When a watched app opens, Warden really switches off Developer options, USB and wireless debugging, and accessibility apps. When you leave, it puts back exactly what was on.
Even after a crash or reboot, it restores from a saved copy.
Changes you make while a watched app is open are undone when you leave.
Set up once
From a computer with adb, run this.
Rather skip the computer? On Android 11+, use Shizuku:
Allow Usage access.
Do the Keep Warden running steps.
Add your apps and tap Start monitor.
Tap Test on this device. Three ticks and you\'re done.
What to add
Any app that complains about developer options, USB debugging or accessibility. Usually banking, payment, trading, government and some game apps.
Day to day
Open your app as usual. Settings switch off in about a second.
Need USB debugging in one of those apps? Tap Pause.
If something doesn\'t come back, you get an alert. Turn it on in Settings.
Watched app still complains?
A few apps check before Warden can switch settings off, so opened from their own icon they still see them on. A Warden widget fixes this: it switches settings off first, then opens the app.
Under Apps to watch, tap Add home screen widget and confirm.
Always open the app from that widget, not its own icon from the drawer.
If the app is already open, swipe it away in Recents first.
Only needed for apps that still complain. Leaving the app restores everything as usual.
Pro tips
Quick adb session? Pause until the screen turns off. It ends by itself.
Add the Warden Quick Settings tile. Long-press it to open the app.
Notification in the way? Tap Hide on it and turn off Monitor. Warden keeps working.
Lock Warden in Recents so Clear all never stops it.
Not working?
Check the top card says Watching. If it says Monitor off, tap Start monitor.
Usage access greyed out? In Warden\'s app settings, tap the three-dot menu, then Allow restricted settings.
Make sure the app is in Apps to watch.
App still complains? Add a Warden widget for it under Apps to watch, close the app fully, then always open it from that widget, not its own icon from the drawer.
Set accessibility back to All services.
Run Test on this device again after big updates.
Root or modified-system checks are beyond Warden.
Uninstalling Warden while a watched app is open leaves those settings off.
